short: Born from war's flames, a Phoenix ascends. In this dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG from Team NINJA, players use offensive and defensive Chinese martial arts to fight back against mighty demons on the battlefields of the Three Kingdoms.

Digital Deluxe Edition Content      Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember Digital Deluxe Edition includes the following content: • Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember base game • Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember Season Pass • Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember Season Pass bonus Creator God Armor set  Digital Deluxe Edition bonuses: • Digital artbook   View never-before-seen images of generals, Divine Beasts, and demons from this title, as well as design art of the various stages in the game and other information. • Digital mini soundtrack   Enjoy your favorite songs from the game! • Shitieshou Hat (in-game item)  Note: - These contents cannot be downloaded as separate files (PDF, MP3, etc.). - None of these contents can be viewed or played outside of the game.   Season pass contents: The season pass includes two major DLCs that will include new stories, enemies, demons, boss characters, and equipment. • DLC 1 is scheduled for release by August 31, 2027. • DLC 2 is scheduled for release by October 31, 2027. • The season pass bonus, Creator God Armor set, is set to be released on the same date as the base game.  Note: - To play or use the content of the season pass, the player must first reach a certain point in the base game. - Please be aware that the contents and release dates of these contents are subject to change without notice.  Please see the official site for details.  - The standard edition of Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember is also being sold. Please confirm that you have selected the correct product before making your purchase. - The base game and season pass that are included in this product are also being sold separately. Please be careful to avoid making duplicate purchases. - The digital artbook and digital mini soundtrack are the digital versions of the original artbook (Japanese version) and original mini soundtrack included in the Treasure Box being sold in certain regions.   Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember Alpha Demo  Born from war's flames, a Phoenix ascends.  Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember is the latest entry in the dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG series. Dive into the Three Kingdoms in this special limited-time demo.  Note: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember Alpha Demo is available for online play. If you do not have an internet connection, you will not be able to play this demo.  Players who are able to complete the demo will be gifted a piece of equipment (the Fledgling Phoenix Helmet) for use in the final release version of the game.      In order to deliver the best possible product to our customers, we will also be conducting a survey to reference during development of the final version of the game. The survey will also be accessible from inside the demo version. We sincerely hope you enjoy the demo and share your impressions and opinions with us.  Key elements of the game: A dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG from Team NINJA. Wield acrobatic Chinese martial arts and conquer the vast battlefields of the Three Kingdoms, where mighty generals and demons stand in your way.  The Three Kingdoms period—an era during which the land is divided into three factions, with heroes fighting for their respective beliefs. Amidst the chaos, Amidst the chaos, a warrior with the power of the phoenix crosses endless battlefields overrun by grotesque demons.  Note: - This content is available for a limited time, until 15:00 (UTC) on September 30, 2026.
